reason: The cited evidence (E1) supports that grain size reduction can enhance coercivity via pinning and that RTA parameters can be tuned for microstructural optimization, but it does not address FeCoNi-based HEAs, the retention of single-phase FCC structure, or the preservation of high saturation magnetization, leaving several key premises unsupported.
premises: Grain refinement increases coercivity by domain wall pinning
RTA time and temperature can be adjusted to reduce grain size
FeCoNi-based HEA can remain single-phase FCC after modified RTA
Increased grain boundary density does not degrade saturation magnetization
Coercivity enhancement observed in other systems applies to FeCoNi HEA
